identity.source_difference_note: Y3-2 source adds the explicit D15 Y3-2 planner/profile route and its tests; D15 numerical operator implementation is unchanged. All three runs use the same relative-only sparse cutoff, mode ordering, surface/volume quadrature, and direct-solve contract.

limitations: All runs are finite R13 rectangles with FULL_DTN_NOT_VERIFIED; this comparison does not qualify omitted DtN channels or the continuum solution.
The sample arrays cover their saved common points only, not the full field. Horizontal E_t/H_t samples are not canonical pillar sidewall traces; sidewall remains NOT_MEASURED.
No phase fitting, interpolation, mesh/field reconstruction, or extra solver action was performed.

Y2 is [6,8,6] with y segments 2/4/2; Y3 is [6,10,6] with y 3/4/3; Y3-2 is [6,10,6] with y 2/6/2. The earlier Y2-to-Y3 v1 metadata typo is preserved historically and corrected in the v2 record; it did not alter any numerical data.

Y2_to_Y3.scope: all 612 ordered FE-port modes; saved same-coordinate samples only; no interpolation or phase fit

Y2_to_Y3_2.scope: all 612 ordered FE-port modes; saved same-coordinate samples only; no interpolation or phase fit

Y3_to_Y3_2.scope: all 612 ordered FE-port modes; saved same-coordinate samples only; no interpolation or phase fit

scope: offline comparison of existing D15 Y2, Y3, and Y3-2 successful runs; no FE/factor/VTU/resource stream read; each small NPZ sample archive loaded once
